note: v3 League 1: decision models and models on our own hardware. Jev 1.13.0, Fastino GLiDE and Celeris-1 Decision dropped (blocked: no key or credit); GPT-6 Luna plays through the ChatGPT subscription, choice only. No clock (smoke-test p90 above 30 s). 2026-10-16 11:04 UTC: Clef, Cygnet and Decider moved to DGX Spark (GB10) servers with the same checkpoints and settings; Open-Jev stayed on the RTX PRO 6000 (2 of 20 replayed requests chose another play on a GB10). 2026-10-16 11:11 UTC: Gemma 4 31B served by three identical replicas behind a proxy (same URL and settings). 2026-10-19: Liquid d1-ultra joins late (league-add). 2026-10-19 18:36 UTC: bariton's GPUs no longer available: Gemma 4 31B moved to one DGX Spark (GB10) server next to Decider (same checkpoint and arguments; 20 replayed (off) requests: same play 19/20); Open-Jev's matches against Liquid d1-ultra wait for its GPU. 2026-10-19 19:31 UTC: reshaped on 2026-10-19 to decision models only: Gemma 4 31B (off), Gemma 4 31B (on), Qwen3.8-27B (off) and Qwen3.8-27B (on) removed (moved to League 2), GPT-6 Luna removed (played via subscription as a chat model; it may rejoin through the OpenAI Decisions API once there is an API key); Cygnet (Gemma 4 12B) stays as a decision model. Their 55 League 1 fixtures (53 played, 2 unfinished) are removed from the league; the matches stay in the database. 2026-10-19 ~21:00 UTC: seven decision models join late (league-add, one at a time, each against every player then in the league): Jev 1.14.0, Jev 1.13.0, Celeris-1 Decision, GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API), Decider Flash v1.2 and Winnow-12B (both on bariton GPU 3 next to Open-Jev), and Mercury Decide (via OpenRouter, out of credit when added: its matches defer until credit is added). Fastino GLiDE stays out (its key is rejected: HTTP 401 invalid_api_key); Decider v1.2 27B waits for memory (49 GB bf16; GPU 3 had 44 GB free next to Open-Jev, spark 20 GB, spark3 5 GB).
